name: EnumScalar
grammar: grammar EnumScalar { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= Mode @value; }

name: EnumOptional
grammar: grammar EnumOptional { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= '[' [Mode] @value ']'; }

name: EnumMany
grammar: grammar EnumMany { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= '[' {Mode} @value ']'; }

name: EnumPlus
grammar: grammar EnumPlus { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= Mode+ @value '!'; }

name: EnumSeparated
grammar: grammar EnumSeparated { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= Mode % ',' @value '!'; }

name: EnumAlias
grammar: grammar EnumAlias { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; Alias ::= Mode; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= Alias @value; }

name: EnumGroup
grammar: grammar EnumGroup { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= ('(' Mode ')') @value; }

name: EnumRoot
grammar: grammar EnumRoot { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @root @enum Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; }

name: EnumAliasRoot
grammar: grammar EnumAliasRoot { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; @root Root ::= Mode; }

name: EnumRollback
grammar: grammar EnumRollback { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= ('a' Mode @value '!' | 'a' Mode @value '?'); }

name: EnumUnicode
EnumMultiple
grammar: grammar EnumMultiple { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; @enum Level ::= 'low' | 'high'; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value,other]) Root ::= Mode @value ':' Level @other; }

name: EnumBounded
grammar: grammar EnumBounded { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync'|'auto'; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= Mode{2,3} @value '!'; }

name: EnumRepeatedSites
grammar: grammar EnumRepeatedSites { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync'|'auto'; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= Mode @value ':' Mode @value; }

name: EnumSpaces
grammar: grammar EnumSpaces { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= ' K '; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= Mode @value; }

name: EnumSkippedAlias
grammar: grammar EnumSkippedAlias { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync'|'auto'; @skip Alias ::= Mode; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= Alias @value; }

name: EnumUnicodeMany
grammar: grammar EnumUnicodeMany { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= '𐐨'|'日本'; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= '[' {Mode} @value ']'; }

name: EnumHelperMany
grammar: grammar EnumHelperMany { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync'|'auto'; Pair ::= Mode ':' Mode; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= Pair @value; }

name: EnumBareMany
grammar: grammar EnumBareMany { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync'|'auto'; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= {Mode} @value; }

name: EnumWhitespace
grammar: grammar EnumWhitespace { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: javaStyle @enum Mode ::= 'sync'|'auto'; @root @mapping(Value,params=[value]) Root ::= Mode @value; }

name: EnumDelimitedRoot
grammar: grammar EnumDelimitedRoot { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum Mode ::= 'sync'|'auto'; @root Root ::= '(' Mode ')'; }

name: ExceptionName
grammar: grammar ExceptionName { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum IllegalArgumentException ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; @root @mapping(Foo_Bar,params=[value]) Root ::= IllegalArgumentException @value; }

name: IgnoredMapping
grammar: grammar IgnoredMapping { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum @mapping(FooBar) Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; @root @mapping(Foo_Bar,params=[value]) Root ::= Mode @value; }

name: IgnoredQualifiedMapping
grammar: grammar IgnoredQualifiedMapping { @package: enumprobe @whitespace: none @enum @mapping(Outer.Inner) Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; @root @mapping(Foo_Bar,params=[value]) Root ::= Mode @value; }
